text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick update 52 8am status: heavy snow forecast overnight for the Bay, transit likely delayed tomorrow. Were activating the Winter Commute Plan. Please read if you were planning to be onsite or host visitors. :snowflake:

Maya (People Ops): TL;DR: SF hub open but optional tomorrow (Thu). If you choose to stay home, mark OOO for the day and optionally claim the Snow-Day Work Stipend. Visitor prereg still required; customer demos should be rescheduled unless essential. Shuttle changes and taxi subsidy info below. Links: visitor prereg https://redwood.internal/forms/visitor-prereg and shuttle sign-up https://redwood.internal/shuttle/sf-winter

Ethan (Facilities): Building remains operational. Security desk limited to 9:00-16:30. No after-hours access. Hot beverage station on 1st floor will be closed for safety; vending machines are available.

Priya (Eng): If my team is fully remote tomorrow, any guidance for oncall coverage?

Maya (People Ops): Keep oncall rotations as usual. If you need to swap shifts because of commute, coordinate with your manager and update the oncall rota. We encourage remote handoffs where possible.

Devon (Sales): I have a customer visiting in the afternoon for a live demo  can we get an exception?

Maya (People Ops): Exceptions for critical customer meetings possible. DM me with exact time, headcount, and sponsor. Well confirm if security and Facilities can support. Please expect extra screening at lobby.

IT Support: Note: temporary guest wifi tokens will only be issued for preregistered visitors and require 24h lead where possible. If you need emergency access for a contractor, open ticket "Guest-WiFi-Emergency".

Transport Bot: Shuttle update: inbound run at 8:45am and outbound at 5:45pm only. Extra on-demand vans available via signup; taxi subsidy (up to $25 one-way) for employees from South Bay & East Bay if shuttle unavailable. Submit receipts in Expensify with tag "Winter-Commute-2026".

Rina (Payroll): Snow-Day Work Stipend: employees who work remotely due to weather may claim a $15 stipend for home office / transit costs. Submit expense with tag "snow-stipend". For caregivers who need to stay home, were offering a one-time child-care stipend of $75 for the day; request via People Ops form.

Ethan (Facilities): Parking: limited visitor parking tomorrow. If you require a spot for a customer, include license plate and time window on the prereg form and allow 2h notice.

Priya (Eng): Will there be any changes to desk booking windows?

Maya (People Ops): No change to booking rules. If you end up remote, please free your desk reservation so others can use it.

Devon (Sales): Thanks  one more Q: will catering be allowed?

Ethan (Facilities): Catering discouraged tomorrow due to access constraints. If essential (customer demo), use a building-approved vendor and request 48h in advance; otherwise please reschedule.

Maya (People Ops): Well re-evaluate overnight and post any new updates by 7:00am. If anything changes sooner well ping #general and update this thread. Questions -> #people-ops or DM me. Stay safe and plan for delays. :white_check_mark:
